ValidationRule.description: Requires an Upsell Type for DB&R, One Time Shred, RM, and Shred
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(NCSP_Service_Line__c,'DB&R'), ISPICKVAL(NCSP_Service_Line__c,'RM'), ISPICKVAL(NCSP_Service_Line__c,'Shred'), ISPICKVAL(NCSP_Service_Line__c,'One Time Shred')), ISBLANK(TEXT(NCSP_Upsell_Type__c)), ispickval( Opportunity__r.Type, "Up-Sell/Lift"), ISPICKVAL( Deal_Type__c , "Upsell")
)
